# Ko-fi

> > Ko-fi is a creator monetization platform that enables artists, writers, podcasters, and content creators to earn income through tips, donations, and memberships from their supporters.

Ko-fi provides a simple way for creators to receive financial support from fans without requiring subscriptions. The platform supports various creator types including artists, photographers, writers, podcasters, and crafters, offering tools for tips, memberships, and selling digital products or commissions.

## Key Topics

- Creator monetization
- Membership platform
- Tips and donations
- Content creators
- Fan support
- Creative income
- Creator economy
- Digital products
- Commissions
- Subscription alternatives
- Artist support
- Patron funding

## Platform Overview

- [Ko-fi | Make money doing what you love](https://ko-fi.com/): Homepage for Ko-fi creator monetization platform with tips and memberships
